## Summary
Salvatore Di Genua is a Senior Frontend Engineer and Angular specialist focused on building maintainable, scalable, and modern web applications. He works on Angular architecture, TypeScript-based frontend engineering, micro-frontends, real-time systems, technical leadership, and AI-assisted development workflows.

## Keywords
frontend engineer, senior frontend developer, Angular developer, Angular specialist, TypeScript engineer, frontend architecture, AI-assisted development, Signals, RxJS, NgRx, micro-frontends, JavaScript, UI engineering, team leadership, technical mentoring, full-stack frontend, Angular library author, UI architecture, software engineering

## Professional profile
Salvatore is currently a Senior IT Consultant focused on Frontend and Application Architecture at Orbyta Tech. His responsibilities include building robust Angular applications, improving architecture quality, supporting team delivery, reviewing code, mentoring developers, and guiding maintainable engineering practices. He is especially interested in modern Angular patterns, developer experience, and scalable frontend systems.

## Featured projects

- [angular-boilerplate](https://github.com/SalvatoreDiGenua/angular-boilerplate): Modern Angular starter project designed around signal-based architecture, SSR, hydration, Tailwind CSS, SEO, internationalization, and testing. Intended as a reusable foundation for modern Angular applications.
- [angular-boilerplate demo](https://stackblitz.com/fork/github/SalvatoreDiGenua/angular-boilerplate/tree/main?startScript=start&title=Angular%20Boilerplate): Live demo on StackBlitz.
- [ngx-request-lock](https://github.com/SalvatoreDiGenua/ngx-request-lock-docs): Angular library for coordinating concurrent HTTP requests and preventing inconsistent UI state during asynchronous flows. Demonstrates Signals, HttpContext, and functional interceptors in modern Angular engineering.
- [ngx-request-lock documentation](https://ngx-request-lock-docs.netlify.app/): Documentation site for the library.
